headline: 1,400+ stars on GitHub for design.md AI agents
summary: A GitHub repository provides AI agents with a persistent design document
details: A GitHub repository called design.md has been trending recently, accumulating over 1,400 stars. The concept is straightforward: provide AI agents with a persistent design document they can reference throughout their work.

The approach addresses a practical challenge in agent development that many teams encounter. AI agents need to understand the broader picture, including architecture, constraints, and previous approaches.

An effective design.md answers questions such as the core purpose of a project, technical and business constraints, and documents failed approaches to prevent agents from suggesting rejected solutions.

headline: Current LLM costs unsustainable for widespread use
summary: High costs of large language models
details: The current costs of large language models (LLMs) are not sustainable for widespread use. This is a major concern for the tech industry.
The high costs are a significant barrier to adoption. Many organizations are hesitant to invest in LLMs due to the expense.
Researchers are exploring ways to reduce costs. New methods and technologies are being developed to make LLMs more affordable.
caption:
Can AI models be made affordable?

The current costs of large language models (LLMs) are not sustainable for widespread use. This is a major concern for the tech industry.

The high costs are a significant barrier to adoption. Many organizations are hesitant to invest in LLMs due to the expense.

Researchers are exploring ways to reduce costs. New methods and technologies are being developed to make LLMs more affordable.
